components.Requests.modifyFailed.currentTarget: Diese Anforderung kann nicht aktualisiert werden.
components.Requests.modifyFailed.suggestedTarget: Diese Anfrage kann nicht aktualisiert werden.
components.Requests.modifyFailed.rationale: “Anforderung” normally reads as requirement/demand here, while the caller is updating a user media request and showing an error toast. “Anfrage” names the request object and preserves the source meaning.

components.Requests.modifyFailed.currentTarget: Impossible de mettre à jour cette requête.
components.Requests.modifyFailed.suggestedTarget: Impossible de mettre à jour cette demande.
components.Requests.modifyFailed.rationale: “Requête” can read as a technical query. The caller updates a user media request; “demande” is the clearer product-domain term.
“要求” can mean a requirement. The caller refers to the user’s request object; “請求” preserves that object meaning and is already used for requests elsewhere in this packet.

components.Requests.noHistory.currentTarget: لم يسجل أي تاريخ للوضع بعد
components.Requests.noHistory.suggestedTarget: لم يُسجَّل أي سجل لحالة الطلب بعد.
components.Requests.noHistory.rationale: The current “تاريخ الوضع” can be read as the date/history of a situation. The caller is an empty request-status-history state; naming the request status record is clearer. Arabic phrasing confidence is limited.

components.Requests.noMediaResults.currentTarget: 映画、ショー、音楽、書籍、コミック、雑誌のリクエストはこれらのフィルターにマッチしません。
components.Requests.noMediaResults.suggestedTarget: 映画、テレビ番組、音楽、書籍、コミック、雑誌、または成人向けコンテンツのリクエストで、これらのフィルターに一致するものはありません。
components.Requests.noMediaResults.rationale: The current sentence omits the source’s final “adult” request category. The all-media empty state must include adult content; the proposed wording restores it and makes “show” explicit as a television program.

components.Requests.noReleaseFoundFilter.rationale: “Publication” refers to a publication/publishing event and shifts the meaning of the media-release status. “Version” is a clearer general rendering for a release found for the requested media.

components.Requests.noResults.currentTarget: Aucune requête ne correspond à ces filtres
components.Requests.noResults.suggestedTarget: Aucune demande ne correspond à ces filtres
components.Requests.noResults.rationale: In this filtered request-list context, “requête” can be read as a query. “Demande” consistently names the user’s media requests and removes that ambiguity.

components.Requests.notAvailable.rationale: The source is a standalone unavailable value used inside detail fields; the added final period is unnecessary UI punctuation.

This generic value is reused for several missing fields, including numeric and metadata values. The feminine adjective assumes an unstated feminine referent; masculine “غير متاح” is a safer generic form. This is a low-confidence Arabic agreement refinement.

components.Requests.olderRequests.currentTarget: {count, plural, =1 {# 旧请求在此窗口之外 。} other {# 旧的请求在此窗口之外。}}
components.Requests.olderRequests.suggestedTarget: {count, plural, =1 {# 旧请求在此窗口之外。} other {# 旧的请求在此窗口之外。}}
components.Requests.olderRequests.rationale: The exact-one branch has a stray space before the full stop. Removing it preserves the meaning and yields standard Chinese punctuation spacing.

components.Requests.olderRequests.currentTarget: {count, plural, =1 {# 舊要求在此視窗外 。} other {# 更早的要求在此視窗外 。}}
components.Requests.olderRequests.suggestedTarget: {count, plural, =1 {# 個較早的請求在此視窗外。} other {# 個較早的請求在此視窗外。}}
components.Requests.olderRequests.rationale: Both branches have a stray space before the full stop, and “要求” can mean requirements rather than the user requests counted by the caller. “請求” aligns with the request-list terminology in this packet.

components.Requests.olderRequests.currentTarget: {count, plural, =1 {# Yêu cầu cũ ở ngoài cửa sổ này.} other {# Yêu cầu cũ ở ngoài cửa sổ này.}}
components.Requests.olderRequests.suggestedTarget: {count, plural, =1 {# yêu cầu cũ ở ngoài cửa sổ này.} other {# yêu cầu cũ ở ngoài cửa sổ này.}}
components.Requests.olderRequests.rationale: After the count marker, “Yêu cầu” is capitalized mid-sentence. Lowercase “yêu cầu” is the conventional styling here; meaning and plural invariance remain intact. Vietnamese idiom confidence is limited.

components.Requests.pages.rationale: The caller uses this as a book page-count label. The current definite singular “الصفحة” means “the page”; plural “الصفحات” matches “Pages” and the count field.

components.Requests.pending.rationale: The status stage is requested/pending. “معلّق” can imply suspended or on hold; “قيد الانتظار” more directly communicates waiting for the next request-status step.
The caller maps the requested stage to this pending label. “보류 중” more strongly means on hold/deferred; “대기 중” better expresses a request awaiting the next step.
